component.name: Files.fm Sync 2025
component.summary: Keep your files synchronized with Files.fm

description.p: Files.fm Sync 2025 is a desktop client that keeps local folders continuously synchronized with your Files.fm account. It is based on the Nextcloud desktop synchronization client.

ul.li: Automatic, continuous synchronization of local folders with your Files.fm account
Virtual files support, keeping a placeholder for files that are not downloaded locally
Support for multiple accounts and folders
